profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary: Building an agentic AI assistant to transform customer support within Airbnb. Improving self-solve rate and CSAT while driving down turn-latency and hallucinations through scalable engineering approaches. Focused on evals, agent reliability, context engineering, agentic tools, and global expansion.

organizations.name: IEEE Eta Kappa Nu (IEEE-HKN)
organizations.description: IEEE-HKN international honor society of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers. Joining HKN is by invitation only.
